name: Lantern Fold
summary: A lantern reduced to a folded jewel, with a small light held inside.
why: A faceted body and a floating cap turn the lantern into a compact emblem. The open center makes the light feel protected, suggesting guidance and moments of reading or prayer after dark.
risk: Lanterns may suggest Ramadan more strongly than year-round prayer; this is a cultural direction rather than a feature diagram.
